sections.title: Security operations
sections.subtitle: Detect, triage and contain with a clear operational response.

sections.heading: Turn security signals into informed action
sections.body:
Define how security signals are investigated, escalated and acted on across your teams and tools. Linkfields provides specialist security services and offers Managed Service engagements; the monitoring scope, operational ownership and service terms are agreed for each engagement.

We work with Splunk SIEM, Qualys and Rapid7. Agree the exact product modules, telemetry and supported integrations during scoping; these tools are not evidence of a pre-integrated stack or vendor partnership. Client system owners retain approval for operational changes, legal decisions and recovery responsibilities unless explicitly agreed otherwise.

sections.heading: Agree who operates and who authorises
sections.description: Define the operating model before onboarding tools. Coverage, responsibilities and service measures belong in an approved scope, not an implied promise.

sections.heading: Scope the service, not an incident report
sections.description: Discuss your operating model, tools and objectives, not an active incident. Do not send logs, personal information, credentials or incident evidence.

items.title: What coverage and response can we expect?
items.description: Hours, time zones, analyst/escalation roles, exclusions, handover and response measures are defined in the agreed service scope. A general enquiry does not create an incident retainer or a response commitment.

items.title: Which tools and integrations are included?
items.description: We work with Splunk SIEM, Qualys and Rapid7. Confirm product modules, log sources, vulnerability scope and supported integrations before onboarding. Vendor software, specialist delivery and managed operations are separate commercial decisions. Confirm applicable NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATT&CK detection mapping and incident-handling methods during scoping.

items.title: Who approves containment and owns evidence?
items.description: Record containment approval, evidence custody, access, retention and recovery handoff in the responsibility matrix. Client legal and notification ownership must be clear, including personal-data handling and cross-border processing. Agree an NDA and secure transfer process before reviewing confidential material.

items.title: How can we buy security operations work?
items.description: Fixed Price suits defined integration or readiness work; Time & Materials suits evolving discovery. Managed Service terms cover an agreed ongoing scope with service measures and governance; Dedicated Team or Outcome-Based models require clear responsibilities and measurable acceptance. Read our privacy policy before enquiring. Vendor software is priced separately. Cloud, AI & Identity Security Baselines and Continuous Compliance & Audit Evidence can support separately agreed control and evidence work.
